summary: Lofi: worn tape and a cheap sampler, dark and soft, slightly unsteady, nothing sharp
body: Everything rolled off above ~8 kHz, fewer bits, a little wobble, hiss or crackle under it. Keys forward and soft; drums back, hats quiet.
Works on any genre: most often hip hop (lofi hip hop), also house, jazz, ambient. Slower suits it: if the genre allows, ease the tempo down over several bars (70–90 BPM for lofi hip hop).
Apply: tape-dust on the master (amount 0..3). Bring the drums down a few dB yourself; the sound changes (Rhodes, softer chords) come from the genre, or from sound/tubular-soft-rhds.
